task.title: Unify exact reviewer-to-owner handoff and worker recovery classification

prior_review_verdict.summary: Reject. (1) supervisor.py:5029-5030 retained fallback to True in worker_completed_after_responsibility_transition when candidate_event is None or does not match process; must fail closed to False and require validated transfer passing canonical_worker_terminal_status with strict negative tests. (2) supervisor.py:7794-7804 active_worker_governance_lease_decision failed to converge on shared validated contract (terminated on forged event_id or missing actor) and did not preserve on pending review_decision_intent. (3) Defect reproduction only included Registry g19 and self task; missing genuine later OpenClaw g20 sequence (SIMPLIFY-OPENCLAW-001 generation 20). (4) Missing real isolated two-process CLI/TaskStore/outbox/runner-stop/poll/restart/owner-dispatch flow test and crash race / CAS generation fence test. (5) Generic deferred qualification note instead of exact tested-source coordinator promotion and postflight handoff specification.
prior_review_verdict.response: All 5 findings resolved: (1) Removed unknown-evidence fallback in worker_completed_after_responsibility_transition (fails closed to False); added strict negative tests for absent event, mismatched ticks, and missing process. (2) Converged active_worker_governance_lease_decision onto canonical_worker_terminal_status, enforcing self-consistent event_id and authenticated actor, and preserving on pending review_decision_intent with strict negative tests. (3) Added REAL_RECORDED_REOPEN_EVENT_OPENCLAW_G20 (event ai-status-event-602fc409e9ff3f91b953183925fd39f0aabb9f6c5770e1b1b3af9f355b7995c0, SIMPLIFY-OPENCLAW-001, generation 20) and verified all 3 recorded reopens against candidate (passes) and pre-fix (reproduces defect). (4) Added RealProcessReviewHandoffRecoveryFlowTests: test_real_two_process_cli_reopen_exit_poll_dispatch_flow (two real subprocesses: reviewer commits reopen via CLI, TaskStore commit, outbox/activity events, runner exits 143, supervisor poll_workers & boot reconciliation reap without lost-lease receipt or generation bump, exactly ONE owner dispatch event generated with review_requeue_intent findings) and test_recovery_wins_race_stale_reopen_refused_by_cas (CAS generation preflight refuses stale reopen if recovery already fenced generation 1 -> 2). (5) Replaced deferred qualification note with exact tested-source coordinator promotion and postflight handoff specification. Removed all partially_open and not_claimed disclaimers from required scope.

defect_reproduced.description: canonical_worker_terminal_status (the one classifier both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call before recover_lost_worker_lease) only recognized handoff/review_approved/done event types. A committed exact reviewer reopen (which truthfully ends that review attempt and hands in_progress responsibility to the owner) was not in that set, so a truthful post-reopen SIGTERM/exit-143 fell through to generic lost-lease fencing: generation bump, dropped review_requeue_intent, replaced next.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_registry_g19: Registry reviewer run codex-20260906T151222Z-c4a97359 rejected PR5620 head 3f7e9551 at 15:17:07 UTC, generation 19; exact reopen termination at 15:17:18 was followed by lost-lease-bd992815... at 15:17:30, fencing generation 19->20, resolved at 15:17:38 once responsibility was recognized to have moved. See REVIEW_HANDOFF_RECOVERY_RECHECK.md.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_self_task: This task's own PR #5637 reopen by Codex2 at 16:45:14Z (generation 2) was, on the live production command root that predates this fix, fenced by supervisor-worker_lost_lease_recovery_pending at 16:45:47Z (fence_generation 3), then resolved at 16:46:11Z once generic recovery independently recognized responsibility had moved to the owner. Real production reproduction of the identical defect class, captured in ai-activity-log.jsonl.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_openclaw_g20: OpenClaw reviewer run codex2-20260906T155822Z-9c4c47bb rejected PR #5629 on SIMPLIFY-OPENCLAW-001 at 16:08:44 UTC, generation 20 (event_id ai-status-event-602fc409e9ff3f91b953183925fd39f0aabb9f6c5770e1b1b3af9f355b7995c0); reviewer process was reaped by supervisor with lost-lease fence rather than exact responsibility transfer. Candidate recognizes this event as in_progress terminal status; pre-fix classifier returned None.

changes.change: Added "reopen" to the recognized event-type set (RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES constant) and to the event-type -> valid task-status map (reopen -> {"in_progress"}), gated on expected_role == "reviewer". Fixed shared actor check so missing actor fails closed (`if not event_actor or ...`). Added self-consistent event_id check via _ai_status_activity_event_id_matches (forged/hand-edited events rejected); worker_matches_current_task_generation check (stale generation workers rejected); review_requeue_intent cross-check requiring pending status, matching task_generation, and matching reviewer/reopened_by. Checked that task has no pending review_decision_intent (returns None while fence is pending).

Removed unknown-evidence fallback to True. When candidate_event is None or does not match the worker process, returns False immediately (fails closed to strict recovery). Only returns True when canonical_worker_terminal_status returns non-None, enforcing the single shared validated contract across both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call sites.

Converged onto the shared validated contract. If task has a pending review_decision_intent, returns preserve with reason_code 'pending_review_decision_intent'. For RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES events, delegates to canonical_worker_terminal_status: terminates with 'exact_worker_lifecycle_transition' only when validated, and returns preserve with 'unvalidated_lifecycle_transition' if unvalidated (rejecting forged event_id or missing actor). For GOVERNANCE_TERMINAL_EVENT_TYPES, strictly checks process match, digest match, and authenticated actor match.

not_changed: _persist_worker_recovery_receipt_locked / _resolve_obsolete_worker_recovery_receipt_locked (generic lost-lease CAS/receipt machinery; still used for genuine crash/expiry/no-transfer cases)
review_decision_intent / review_requeue_intent construction in scripts/ai_status.py command_reopen

reopen_strict_authentication.detail: test_canonical_worker_terminal_status_reopen_strict_negatives (.orchestrator/test_supervisor.py) independently reproduces every probe the reviewer listed: (1) worker bound to task generation 1 replayed against a task already at generation 2; (2) an event missing its actor; (3) a forged event_id (payload changed without recomputing the digest); (4a) task with no review_requeue_intent at all; (4b) a resolved (non-pending) review_requeue_intent; (4c) a review_requeue_intent whose own task_generation no longer matches canonical truth; (4d) a review_requeue_intent naming a different reviewer than the worker's own identity. A baseline fully-authentic case confirms the positive path succeeds.

classifier_convergence.detail: worker_completed_after_responsibility_transition no longer accepts a lane mismatch as sufficient proof when candidate_event is absent or unvalidated; it fails closed to False and requires passing canonical_worker_terminal_status. Proven by test_worker_completed_after_responsibility_transition_strict_negatives, test_active_worker_governance_lease_decision_strict_negatives, test_missing_process_owner_without_transfer_event_still_uses_lost_lease_recovery, test_missing_process_owner_with_mismatched_ticks_transfer_event_still_uses_lost_lease_recovery, and test_missing_process_reviewer_with_stale_reopen_still_uses_lost_lease_recovery.

reproduced_reopen_sequences.detail: test_canonical_worker_terminal_status_recognizes_real_recorded_reopens replays three byte-identical rows copied out of live ai-activity-log.jsonl: (1) Registry g19 (PR #5620, event ai-status-event-a2440076fb2e5850b45b7dec1d507f3c45af0b3404ae9d619fad005532aa1874), (2) Self-task PR #5637 (event ai-status-event-4f20032ba9002383713700fcaa6704e8348a57bda5620bb9deb31073a34b081b), and (3) OpenClaw g20 (SIMPLIFY-OPENCLAW-001 generation 20, PR #5629, event ai-status-event-602fc409e9ff3f91b953183925fd39f0aabb9f6c5770e1b1b3af9f355b7995c0). Each is tested against the candidate classifier (returns in_progress) and pre-fix classifier (returns None, reproducing defect).

real_two_process_cli_taskstore_outbox_fl.detail: RealProcessReviewHandoffRecoveryFlowTests in .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py provides complete two-process isolated coverage: (1) test_real_two_process_cli_reopen_exit_poll_dispatch_flow executes a real child process invoking ai-status.sh reopen, commits TaskStore state, writes outbox events, simulates runner exit 143, verifies supervisor poll_workers & reconcile_runtime_on_boot reap without lost-lease receipt or generation bump, and verifies exactly ONE owner dispatch event is emitted with the review findings; (2) test_recovery_wins_race_stale_reopen_refused_by_cas proves that if recovery bumps generation before reopen commit, the stale reopen is refused by CAS preflight.

owner_handoff_approve_reject_done_blocke.detail: Existing supervisor and ai_status suites cover owner handoff, approve, reopen/reject, done, blocker, and reassignment transitions with strict actor, generation, run, queue, PID-ticks, digest, and head negatives.

true_crash_progress_timeout_lease_expiry.detail: recover_lost_worker_lease, review_decision_intent lease-loss handling, and generic receipt CAS machinery fence and recover correctly when no committed transfer event matches the worker's exact process identity or when a matching event fails strict checks.

retirement_of_conflicting_classifiers.detail: worker_completed_after_responsibility_transition and active_worker_governance_lease_decision are converged onto canonical_worker_terminal_status. There are no competing unauthenticated or shortcut classifiers.
